newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Securum now holds 10.2 pct of Akzo Nobel.
newsitem.headline: Securum now holds 10.2 pct of Akzo Nobel.

text.p: Chemicals group Akzo Nobel NV said on Thursday that Sweden's state-owned Securum AB currently had a 10.2 percent stake in it.
Earlier the Dutch company said Securum planned to sell its remaining Akzo shares through a bookbuilding procedure, expected to start after today's Amsterdam stock exchange close.

On behalf of Akzo Nobel and Securum, ABN AMRO Rothschild will carry out the bookbuilding which includes selling an unidentified number of shares to investment firm Arnhemsche maatschappij tot het houden van aandelen Akzo Nobel.
The shares will not be offered in the U.S., Akzo Nobel said.
Last year, Securum sold a five percent stake in the Dutch chemicals group, bringing its stake then to 13.2 percent.
The Swedish company became owner of the Akzo Nobel shares when Akzo took over Sweden's Nobel in 1993.
Securum was a majority shareholder in Nobel.
